using JSON3
out = Dict{String,Any}()
try
    import Pkg
    bk = "/scratch/coop/drozda/default-env-backup-before-JACC-1.5.1-20261121"
    t = mktempdir(get(ENV, "WORK", "/tmp"))
    for f in ("Project.toml", "Manifest.toml", "LocalPreferences.toml"); cp(joinpath(bk, f), joinpath(t, f)); end
    Pkg.activate(t)
    r = try Pkg.precompile(["Gmsh"]); "ok" catch e; first(sprint(showerror, e), 700) end
    out["gmsh_precompile_with_pre_change_env"] = r
    out["backup_jacc_line"] = filter(l -> occursin("JACC", l) || occursin("version", l) && false, split(read(joinpath(bk, "Manifest.toml"), String), '\n'))[1:2]
    rm(t; recursive = true, force = true)
catch e
    out["error"] = first(sprint(showerror, e, catch_backtrace()), 1500)
end
println(JSON3.write(out))
